findings.failureScenario: total_ram_gb is a second per-OS probe (/proc/meminfo, powershell, sysctl) that only runs when available_ram_mb already failed, and halves installed RAM as a guess. On Linux and Windows the same file/PowerShell source that failed for available RAM is very likely to fail here too, so the fallback is largely dead flexibility; only a macOS vm_stat parse failure reaches it usefully.
